name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral analysis to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index). It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对RVI（相对活力指数）进行频谱分析处理。当RVI主线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用经频谱分析处理后的RVI指标的线间交叉来捕捉动量转折点。入场条件为：当Line1（RVI主线）从下方穿越Line2（RVI信号线）时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号；同时在上一根K线已确认趋势方向的前提下才开仓，即Line1[1]>Line2[1]且Line1[0]<=Line2[0]时才触发买入，这实际上是一种回拉入场而非突破入场。出场条件依赖止损止盈参数，同时支持反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose可配置）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的两种模式（LOT和MMMode）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数处理开平仓逻辑，包含滑点容忍设置Deviation_。策略使用SignalBar参数控制信号检测的K线位置，默认为1即使用已完成K线信号，避免未来函数问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy captures momentum turning points using crossover signals from a spectrally-analyzed RVI indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Line1 (RVI main) crosses above Line2 (RVI signal), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover; however, the EA requires confirmation from the previous bar (Line1[1]>Line2[1]) combined with a pullback (Line1[0]<=Line2[0]) to trigger buys, making this a pullback-entry rather than a breakout-entry system. Exit conditions rely on configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit levels, with optional reverse-signal closes (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose toggles). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based proportional sizing through two modes (LOT and MMMode). Money management leverages standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for opening and closing positions, including a slippage tolerance setting (Deviation_). The strategy uses SignalBar to control which bar's signal is evaluated, defaulting to 1 (last completed bar), which avoids repainting issues.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数或保证金比例
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平多）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平空）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号检测的K线索引位置

pros: 使用频谱分析处理RVI信号，有效滤除高频噪声，信号质量更优
支持多种仓位管理模式和开关控制，灵活性高
采用已完成K线信号（SignalBar=1），避免未来函数重绘问题
设有新K线检测机制，避免同一信号重复开仓
pros_en: Spectral analysis preprocessing of RVI effectively filters high-frequency noise, yielding cleaner signals
Supports multiple position sizing modes and toggle switches for buy/sell open/close, offering high flexibility
Uses completed bar signals (SignalBar=1) to avoid repainting issues
Implements new bar detection to prevent duplicate entries on the same signal
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在不同行情下可能不适用
无持仓检查逻辑，可能存在同方向重复开仓的风险
依赖自定义指标i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
未设置点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致入场成本过高
cons_en: Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment may be unsuitable across varying market conditions
No position existence check before opening new orders, risking duplicate same-direction positions
Depends on the custom indicator i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI; if the indicator file is missing the EA fails to initialize
No spread filter; high-spread environments could make entries excessively costly
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认是否已有同方向持仓，避免重复开仓
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动环境
增加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时暂停开仓
improvements_en: Add position existence check before opening new orders to prevent duplicate same-direction entries
Replace fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a spread filter to suspend new entries when spread exceeds a configurable threshold

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能在同一方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
固定止损止盈无法适应市场波动率变化，震荡市和趋势市可能都不适用
无点差过滤，在流动性不足时滑点成本可能显著
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate same-direction entries, leading to excessive risk exposure
Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit cannot adapt to changing market volatility, potentially unsuitable for both ranging and trending markets
No spread filter means slippage costs can be significant during low-liquidity periods
